message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-10 05:10 IST to 2026-11-11 05:10 IST (2026-11-09 23:40 to 2026-11-10 23:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. Obvious aliases, spelling variants, and repeated versioned entries were normalized and deduplicated; administrative project/migration rows were excluded. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

New relevant issues were confirmed for MongoDB Server, monitored Microsoft products, Mozilla Firefox, and Adobe Photoshop. The highest-priority items are two MongoDB Server CVEs with CVSS scores of 9.5 and 9.1, plus an actively exploited Microsoft Outlook vulnerability.

### Finding 1 — MongoDB Server: CVE-2026-118383

- **Severity:** CVSS 9.5 (vendor score)
- **Description:** A pre-authentication use-after-free in replica-set primary catch-up can be triggered in MongoDB Server's replication component.
- **Affected versions:** 9.0 before 9.0.7; 8.3 before 8.3.16; 8.0 before 8.0.37; 7.0 before 7.0.48; 6.0 before 6.0.30; 5.0 before 5.0.35; and 4.4 before 4.4.32.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB is explicitly monitored, and the vendor alert directly names MongoDB Server.
- **Source:** [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 2 — MongoDB Server: CVE-2026-120808

- **Severity:** CVSS 9.1 (vendor score)
- **Description:** MongoDB's macOS TLS client may skip a certificate trust result for IPv6 connections, allowing certificate-validation bypass.
- **Affected versions:** 9.0 before 9.0.7; 8.3 before 8.3.16; 8.0 before 8.0.37; and 7.0 before 7.0.48.
- **Relevance:** This is a directly confirmed MongoDB Server flaw in the monitored product family.
- **Source:** [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 3 — MongoDB Server: 24 additional CVEs in the November 10 vendor batch

- **Severity:** CVSS 2.3–8.7, as scored by MongoDB.
- **CVEs:** CVE-2026-120819, CVE-2026-120828, CVE-2026-120826, CVE-2026-120825, CVE-2026-120824, CVE-2026-120823, CVE-2026-120822, CVE-2026-120821, CVE-2026-120820, CVE-2026-120818, CVE-2026-120817, CVE-2026-120816, CVE-2026-120815, CVE-2026-120814, CVE-2026-120813, CVE-2026-120812, CVE-2026-120811, CVE-2026-120810, CVE-2026-120809, CVE-2026-120807, CVE-2026-120806, CVE-2026-120805, CVE-2026-120804, and CVE-2026-120803.
- **Description:** The batch covers authorization failures, use-after-free and race-condition defects, denial of service/resource exhaustion, information exposure, privilege escalation, plaintext handling of encrypted fields, and Kerberos/X.509 authentication weaknesses. Affected-version ranges differ by CVE; the vendor records commonly identify fixed baselines including 9.0.7, 8.3.16, 8.0.37, and 7.0.48, with some issues also affecting older supported branches.
- **Relevance:** Every item is explicitly identified by MongoDB as affecting MongoDB Server.
- **Source:** [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 4 — Microsoft Outlook: CVE-2026-124194

- **Severity:** Moderate, CVSS 6.5 (Microsoft/Tenable reporting); exploitation detected.
- **Description:** Opening a crafted Office file can disclose a user's NTLMv2 hash, which may support impersonation in follow-on attacks.
- **Relevance:** Microsoft Office is monitored, and Outlook is part of that product family.
- **Source:** [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/), [Tenable November 2026 Patch Tuesday analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsoft-november-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-1093-cves-cve-2026-124194)

### Finding 5 — Microsoft November 2026 security release

- **Severity:** 63 Critical, 1,029 Important, and 1 Moderate CVE in Tenable's analysis of the Microsoft release.
- **Description:** The release includes 1,093 CVEs across 287 products/components. Monitored matches include SQL Server (53 CVEs), Microsoft Office applications, supported Windows/Windows Server components, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, PowerShell, Windows Admin Center, IIS, and Microsoft Defender. Notable examples include CVE-2026-118146 (Active Directory Domain Services RCE, CVSS 8.8), CVE-2026-119952 (Windows Schannel RCE, CVSS 8.1), CVE-2026-121662 (Visual Studio Code RCE, CVSS 8.6), and CVE-2026-121663 (Visual Studio Code security-feature bypass, CVSS 8.8).
- **Relevance:** These product families appear in the monitored lists. Applicability must be checked against deployed editions and support status; this digest does not infer that the specifically listed Windows Server 2012 R2 build is covered by every current update.
- **Source:** [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/), [Tenable November 2026 Patch Tuesday analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsoft-november-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-1093-cves-cve-2026-124194)

### Finding 6 — Mozilla Firefox 160 and ESR updates

- **Severity:** High (Mozilla advisory impact).
- **Description:** Mozilla released Firefox 160, Firefox ESR 153.7, and Firefox ESR 115.45 with a large set of security fixes, including memory-safety defects, sandbox escapes, privilege escalation, same-origin-policy bypasses, and site-isolation issues. High-impact examples include CVE-2026-124852, CVE-2026-124853, CVE-2026-124874, and CVE-2026-124905, with the complete set individually listed in MFSA 2026-125; ESR 115.45 also fixes CVE-2026-109736, CVE-2026-124853, CVE-2026-124952, and CVE-2026-124857.
- **Relevance:** Mozilla Firefox is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Mozilla Firefox 160 advisory (MFSA 2026-125)](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-125/), [Mozilla Firefox ESR 115.45 advisory (MFSA 2026-126)](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-126/), [Mozilla advisory index](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/)

### Finding 7 — Adobe Photoshop: five arbitrary-code-execution CVEs

- **Severity:** High, CVSS 7.8 each.
- **CVEs:** CVE-2026-113575, CVE-2026-117547, CVE-2026-117546, CVE-2026-116480, and CVE-2026-116003.
- **Description:** Heap-buffer-overflow, out-of-bounds-write, and use-after-free flaws can lead to arbitrary code execution when a user opens a malicious file.
- **Affected versions:** Photoshop 2026 27.11 and earlier and Photoshop 2025 26.11.8 and earlier on Windows and macOS.
- **Relevance:** Adobe Photoshop is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Adobe bulletin APSB26-181](https://www.adobe.com/trust/security/products/photoshop/apsb26-181.html)

### Finding 8 — Adobe Photoshop: eight additional CVEs

- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 5.5 each.
- **CVEs:** CVE-2026-113578, CVE-2026-113571, CVE-2026-113569, CVE-2026-115345, CVE-2026-114373, CVE-2026-118200, CVE-2026-118199, and CVE-2026-118198.
- **Description:** These flaws can cause application denial of service or memory exposure after user interaction with crafted content. Adobe states it is not aware of exploitation in the wild.
- **Relevance:** Adobe Photoshop is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Adobe bulletin APSB26-181](https://www.adobe.com/trust/security/products/photoshop/apsb26-181.html)

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major officially maintained libraries/services, MongoDB-owned advisories whose titles might omit “MongoDB,” NVD/CVE records, GitHub advisories, and CISA sources. The 26 MongoDB Server CVEs above were confirmed in scope; no additional fresh, credible finding for the other MongoDB ecosystem categories survived validation.

### Possible matches needing review

No unconfirmed candidate had enough credible, in-window evidence to retain here.

**Closing:** Immediate review is recommended. Prioritize exposure checks and vendor-fixed versions for CVE-2026-118383 and CVE-2026-120808, then address the exploited Outlook issue and assess the broader Microsoft, Firefox, and Photoshop updates against deployed versions.
